newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan king meets Libyan envoy in Rabat.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan king meets Libyan envoy in Rabat.

text.p: King Hassan of Morocco on Tuesday met Libyan Secretary of Unity Affairs Jomaa al-Fezzani who has recently criticised a rapid intervention force (Eurofor) set up earlier this month by four European countries.
The official MAP news agency said the king received al-Fezzani at the royal palace of Bouznika, 20 km (12 miles) south of Rabat but gave no other details on the meeting.
Officials at the foreign ministry were not immediately available for comment.

Al-Fezzani, who arrived in Morocco on Thursday, was quoted by MAP as saying he carried a message from Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi to King Hassan "on issues of common interest to the Arab Maghreb Union (AMU) and the Mediterranean".
Fezzani has also visited Tunisia and Algeria, another member of the AMU.

Libyan is campaigning against Eurofor -- comprising forces from France, Italy, Spain and Portugal -- which it described as "a threat for the security, sovereignty and independence of the AMU countries."
The AMU was established in Marrakesh in 1989 and includes Algeria, Libya, Mauritania, Morocco and Tunisia.
